title: Hidesight
summary: Hidesight is a spell used to completely hide objects or Titans from sight. This spell is similar to Camoforge, which is used to turn the caster invisible.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Hidesight was used by Stack to make Divine Mirror Kagami invisible in order to ambush the Huntik Team on the Avalon island. The spell was of good help when Zhalia Moon tried using her King Basilisk's Stonegaze ability to petrify the Organization, with Divine Mirror Kagami suddenly revealing himself and redirecting the Titan's ability to the Huntik Team, turning Dante Vale and King Basilisk to stone instead. [Knight of the Willblade]

The spell later was used by Den Fears to hide a Stopglue trap meant to neutralize the Casterwill Hunters guarding the entrance of Phoenix Volcano. Four Casterwill Hunters, unable to see the trap because of the spell, ended up being stuck to it. [The Phoenix's Ashes]
